rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when someone carries on as if nothing serious is happening.

example.english: They blithely walked into the restaurant for dinner after just crashing someone else's car.
example.traditional: 明明啱啱撞爛咗人哋部車，佢仲若無其事咁行入餐廳食飯。
example.jyutping: ming4 ming4 ngaam1 ngaam1 zong6 laan6 zo2 jan4 dei6 bou6 ce1 keoi5 zung6 joek6 mou4 kei4 si6 gam3 haang4 jap6 caan1 teng1 sik6 faan6

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on acting carelessly or without paying attention to consequences.

example.english: They blithely signed the contract without reading the terms carefully.
example.traditional: 佢漫不經心咁簽咗份合約，完全冇睇清楚條款。
example.jyutping: keoi5 maan6 bat1 ging1 sam1 gam3 cim1 zo2 fan6 hap6 joek3 jyun4 cyun4 mou5 tai2 cing1 co2 tiu4 fun2

rows.note: Use this when the person seems complacently carefree or overly confident that nothing will go wrong.

example.english: They blithely left home without an umbrella, even though they knew the Observatory had forecast heavy rain.
example.traditional: 佢大安旨意咁出門口，連雨遮都唔帶，明知天文台話會落大雨。
